<!-- Generated by esquadro docs from the blueprint's manifest: do not edit. -->

Tests against a real Postgres: package postgrestest starts one container per test binary, migrates a template database and gives each test a fresh copy. Blueprints that generate tests (store, rest) write them only with it. Tests need Docker.

```esquadro
blueprint testcontainers
```

## Works with

- **Requires** [postgres](../postgres/), [migrations](../migrations/): the app must use them too.

## Go modules

- `github.com/testcontainers/testcontainers-go` v0.40.0
- `github.com/testcontainers/testcontainers-go/modules/postgres` v0.40.0
